crates/vector-platform/tests/ep006_process.rs (replaced unnecessary clones with std::slice::from_ref, and added three direct tests for strip_denied)
crates/vector-study/tests/ep006_motivation_separation.rs (added a direct shape-guard test after the first mutation attempt proved the guard could be vacuous)
gate_files_modified_during_node: Cargo.toml workspace dependencies (added regex, used by credential-shape redaction)
hardcoded_fixture_risks: The canary values in tests are sentinels, which is their purpose; the scheme patterns are also exercised with no canary registered so detection does not depend on them
catch_and_ignore_risks: The environment denylist sweep was unreachable through build_env, so removing it changed nothing observable and the mutation survived. It was extracted into a testable strip_denied() with three direct tests. A barrier whose failure path is untested is an assumed barrier.
reason: Six requirements implemented across four new modules with 91 tests. The pre-existing redaction was key-name-only and would have leaked a credential appearing in a panic message, stack trace or log line; the new crash module adds value-shape detection plus a canary pass and an independent verification gate. 25 of 26 mutations detected, with the one exception analyzed and documented as provably undetectable.
real_vulnerabilities_found: The existing RedactedLogger redacted by key name only, so a credential inside a panic message, stack trace or log line would have shipped unredacted in a crash report
The environment denylist sweep was an untested safety net whose removal was undetectable
known_limitations: REQ-047 provider-policy disablement is implemented and tested in vector-llm::transport (EP-004); EP-006 adds only the egress constraint that a policy refresh must not carry learner data. No live provider is contacted (PREFLIGHT PF-007..PF-009 remain external gates).
Crash captures are built and redacted in memory. Wiring them to a real panic hook and to disk is EP-008 work; no end-to-end capture-from-a-real-panic claim is made here.
The egress classifier is a pure policy function and no network client calls it yet, because the transports that would perform egress are not live-invoked in this environment.
Difficulty calibration is an internal heuristic from observed accuracy and is explicitly not validated against any official psychometric model.
REQ-045 is satisfied by separation rather than by building motivation features: no streak or achievement system exists yet, and tests assert no motivational term enters mastery or readiness.
